title: Clustering and Token Denoising for Faster and More Robust VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.19285v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have enhanced the capabilities of pre-trained LLMs by adding vision tokens alongside text, with approaches like LLaVA showing impressive results. However, the computational burden of processing up to 576 or 729 visual tokens makes edge deployment challenging. While various token pruning techniques require retraining, some are training-free and thus can easily adapt to architecture changes. We introduce ClustRS, a two-part, training-free algorithm for robust token pruning. Its first component is an attention-weighted, clustering algorithm that selects representative tokens from each semantic cluster. The second component, Residual Shrinkage, is a one-pass denoising step on the selected tokens. These training-free lightweight steps make LLaVA ready for real-world data, improving robustness to a wide range of image-noise types and intensities. Experimental results on the ScienceQA-IMG and MM-VET benchm

translated_title: 聚类与令牌去噪：实现更快更稳健的视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19285v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近期视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过将视觉令牌与文本结合，增强了预训练大型语言模型的能力，LLaVA等方法展示了令人印象深刻的结果。然而，处理多达576或729个视觉令牌的计算负担使得边缘部署面临挑战。虽然各种令牌剪枝技术需要重新训练，但一些免训练方法能够轻松适应架构变化。我们引入了ClustRS，一种由两部分组成的免训练算法，用于稳健的令牌剪枝。其第一部分是一种注意力加权的聚类算法，从每个语义簇中选择代表性令牌。第二部分是残差收缩，一种对所选令牌进行的一次性去噪步骤。这些免训练的轻量级步骤使LLaVA能够适应真实世界数据，提高对多种图像噪声类型和强度的鲁棒性。在ScienceQA-IMG和MM-VET基准上的实验结果表明...
tldr: 本文提出ClustRS，一种免训练的聚类与残差去噪两阶段算法，显著提升视觉语言模型在边缘设备上的推理速度和对图像噪声的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ClustRS, a training-free two-stage algorithm combining clustering and residual denoising, which significantly improves inference speed and robustness to image noise in visual language models for edge deployment.
